title: Fixed-Wing Aircraft Airframe Mechanic, F-35 (GySgt to Pvt) PMOS, DC AVN
raw_text:
16. MOS 6258, Fixed-Wing Aircraft Airframe Mechanic, F-35 (GySgt to Pvt)
PMOS, DC AVN

    a. Summary. Fixed-Wing Aircraft Airframe Mechanics, F35 inspect,
service, maintain, and repair aircraft airframe structures, composite
material, hydraulic systems, pneumatic systems, and landing gear systems.

       b.   Prerequisites

            (1) Must be a U.S. citizen.

            (2) Must have normal color perception.

            (3) Must have a five year term of enlistment.

            (4) Must possess a MM score of 95 or higher.

            (5) Security requirement:     secret security clearance eligibility.

       c.   Requirements

            (1) Complete the following course(s):

                (a) Aviation Structural Mechanic Core Course (N23WSG2).

                (b) F-35 Airframes Systems Technician Course (N56F3X2).

            (c) E-4 and above lateral movers who have completed the Aviation
Structural Mechanic Core Course (N23WSG2), may attend the F-35 Aircraft



                                           3-397                        Enclosure (1)
 3140                                                                  NAVMC 1200.1L



Mechanic Organizational Maintenance Course at VMFAT 501 (M16F3X1) or VMFAT-
502 (M17F3XC).

    d. Duties. For a complete listing of duties and tasks, refer to
reference(s) (ad) COMNAVAIRFORINST and 4790.2 (bn) NAVMC 4790.1.

       e.   Related Standard Occupational Classification (SOC) Title and Code

            (1) First-Line Supervisors of Mechanics, Installers, and Repairers
49-1011.

            (2) Aircraft Mechanics and Service Technicians 49-3011.

            (3) Cleaners of Vehicles and Equipment 53-7061.

       f.   Related Military Skill

            (1) Helicopter Airframe Mechanic, CH-53, 6153.

            (2) Helicopter Airframe Mechanic, UH/AH-1, 6154.

            (3) Tiltrotor Airframe Mechanic, MV-22, 6156.

            (4) Fixed-Wing Aircraft Airframe Mechanic, AV/TV-8 6252.

            (5) Fixed-Wing Aircraft Airframe Mechanic, KC-130, 6256.

            (6) Fixed-Wing Aircraft Airframe Mechanic, F/A-18, 6257.

nlx_method: NLx employer-demand profiles; private-only ownership unverified. Six-digit profiles pool specialty weighted task incidences after the existing review exclusion mask and five-job task-support floor; destination SOCs require 200 postings and nonzero tasks. Military profiles use binary accepted task presence and the same NLx reference RCA weights as civilian profiles: reciprocal positive task shares (zero weight for reference-absent tasks) of pooled retained support-five NLx weighted incidences across 1,016 reference specialties (912 eligible comparison candidates), sqrt(q * rca_weight), then L2 normalization and cosine. No military crosswalk codes enter the task ranking. All positive top-20 results retained; zero-similarity destinations are not recommendations. Shared field/rating duties are included; general Naval Standards remain separate by paygrade. Summary compares non-future individual source entries (versions can repeat) with nonempty reference sets; grouped, future and general-standard entries remain in all outputs. Hit@k is the fraction with at least one reference SOC recovered; ties are averaged exactly. References outside NLx remain in denominators. DMDC reference status is from July 2024, not current 2026 status.
